Open the downloaded NDS in your Android DS emulator. Start a new game to test the opening, or import a backed-up earlier prototype normal save, including 0023 through your emulator. Emulator save states should not be transferred between builds.

This is an opening prototype, not a complete Yellow remake. Route 1 now opens after Mom gives you Running Shoes. The cashier greets you outside Viridian and escorts you into the Mart. Deliver Oak’s Parcel to receive the National Pokédex. Route 25 and Bill’s separation scene are converted. The returning robbed-house/Dig quest follows in the next checkpoint. Imported saves keep their caught records, but Pokédex access waits for parcel delivery. Route 25 uses Yellow’s nine trainer teams, levels, dialogue and grass encounters. Its solid item ball gives reusable TM19 Seismic Toss. Bill visibly enters the left chamber; use his PC beside the left wall to separate him, watch him leave the right chamber, and receive the S.S. Ticket. His PC later displays his favorite Eevee family. Earlier features and normal save progress carry forward; use Continue and keep a backup. Johto terrain and Route 25’s terrain remain unchanged. Earlier patches remain available separately.
